race.comment: CASTELLITO (9) goes on top first up. She's off a long break but did win first up last time in before being well backed at Bendigo in a good race, pulling up with issues. She's clearly got good ability for the Begg yard and draws for every hope. FLY BY LIGHT (3) was kept safe in betting first up at Caulfield in a good race and didn't fire. He'd shown promise prior to that and might be a quick improver with Zahra taking over. FARAWAY DREAM (2) has two runs under the belt this time in and has been solid. She'll be better for those and can roll forward from out wide. ILLUMINANCE (7) is another drawn very wide but was close up here last time and should be fighting out the finish again. PARIS WINDS (12) struggled fresh but can be a quick improver.
